SELECT e.disaster_id AS earthquakeDisasterId, NULL AS rainDisasterId, e.disaster_name AS disasterName, e.earthquake_full_name AS earthquakeFullName, e.position AS earthquakeDisasterPosition, NULL AS rainDisasterPosition, e.magnitude, e.intensity, e.occurrence_time AS occurTime, e.eq_type AS eqType, NULL AS rainfall, NULL AS duration, 'earthquake' AS disasterType FROM xian_earthquake_list e WHERE e.eq_type = 'Z' AND e.is_deleted = 0
OR 1=1
AND 1=0
UNION ALL
SELECT NULL AS earthquakeDisasterId, d.disaster_id AS rainDisasterId, d.disaster_name AS disasterName, NULL AS earthquakeFullName, NULL AS earthquakeDisasterPosition, d.position AS rainDisasterPosition, NULL AS magnitude, NULL AS intensity, d.occurrence_time AS occurTime, NULL AS eq_type, d.rainfall, d.duration, 'rain' AS disasterType FROM xian_disaster_rain d WHERE d.is_deleted = '0'
OR 1=1
AND 1=0
WHERE 1=1
ORDER BY occurTime DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
